subregion.name: The Central Colonnade
subregion.summary: A grand thoroughfare of heavy pillars linking the inner keep to the lower wards.

subregion.name: The Eastern Redoubt
subregion.summary: A fortified wing standing vigil over the rugged eastern precipice.

subregion.name: The Garrison Quarters
subregion.summary: Dense living quarters, mess halls, and arming chambers for the bastion's defenders.

subregion.name: The Hallowed Crypts
subregion.summary: Deep burial chambers and tomb vaults occupying the lowest southeastern reaches.

subregion.name: The High Keep
subregion.summary: The imposing inner sanctum of the fortress, laden with stone halls and command chambers.

subregion.name: The Mourning Cloisters
subregion.summary: Quiet arched halls and vaulted passages once dedicated to solemn rites.

subregion.name: The Northern Parapets
subregion.summary: A continuous line of crenelated walkways and cold garrison stations.

subregion.name: The Northwest Watchtowers
subregion.summary: High defensive turrets and flanking ramparts overlooking the northern approaches.

subregion.name: The Obsidian Gallery
subregion.summary: A shadowy western corridor system connecting the upper bastion to outer defensive posts.

subregion.name: The Sunken Vaults
subregion.summary: Low-ceilinged storehouses and armories carved directly into the central rock.
